answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a thread as the anchor of the cost.
